notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages - Soundtrack available and Patch 1.02!
notes.notes: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Soundtrack DLC[/b] is now available on Steam to purchase, check out the page![/p][p][/p][p]It includes [b]50 pieces of music[/b] from the original game[/p][p align="start"](This Item will be updated with the release of every additional DLC.)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Also Patch 1.02 is now available and includes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixes for Chinese Traditional and Chinese Simplified translations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for Japanese and Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A new patch is on the way too and will include several bug fixes based on your feedback,[/p][p]thank you so much for the support and keep us updates in the forum![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/[/url][/p]
